```{r cars}
CSBs.dt <- fread("results/archaea_CSBfinder_q2_ins3_cs_instances_FAS_single.tsv", sep = "\t", col.names =  c("CSB_ID", "Length", "Score", "Instance_Count", "CSB", "Family_ID", "Genome", "Locus"), header = F)
Taxonomy.dt <- fread("data/ar122_taxonomy_r202_wide.tsv", header = F, col.names = c("Genome", "Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus",  "Species"))
Taxonomy.dt[,NperPhylum := .N, by =.(Phylum)]
interestNOGs <- fread("data/SaciNOGs.txt", header = F)$V1
CSBs.census.dt <- CSBs.dt[,.(CSB_ID, Length, Score, Instance_Count, CSB, Family_ID, Genome, Locus, COG0183= 0,COG1028 = 0, COG1064 =0,COG1250 = 0, COG1545 =0,COG2030 =0,COG1960 =0),]
CSBs.census.dt[grep("COG0183@1", CSB, fixed = T), COG0183 :=1]
CSBs.census.dt[grep("COG1028@1", CSB, fixed = T), COG1028 :=1]
CSBs.census.dt[grep("COG1064@1", CSB, fixed = T), COG1064 :=1]
CSBs.census.dt[grep("COG1960@1", CSB, fixed = T), COG1960 :=1]
CSBs.census.dt[grep("COG1250@1", CSB, fixed = T), COG1250 :=1]
CSBs.census.dt[grep("COG1545@1", CSB, fixed = T), COG1545 :=1]
CSBs.census.dt[grep("COG2030@1", CSB, fixed = T), COG2030 :=1]
CSBs.census.dt[,completeness:= (COG0183+COG1545+COG1028+COG1064+COG2030) / 5]
CSBs.census.tax.dt<- merge(CSBs.census.dt, Taxonomy.dt, by = "Genome", all.x = T)
```





```{r ComplexSearch}

Complex.CSBs.census.tax.Complex.dt <- unique(CSBs.census.tax.dt[COG1545 == 1][COG0183 ==1][,.( Length,CSB_ID,Family_ID),by = .(Genome, Species, Locus,Phylum, NperPhylum,CSB)])
Complex.CSBs.census.tax.Complex.cons.dt <- unique(Complex.CSBs.census.tax.Complex.dt[,.(Conservation = ( .N/NperPhylum)*100),by=.(Family_ID,Phylum,CSB_ID,CSB, NperPhylum)])

Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.dt <- unique(CSBs.census.tax.dt[COG1545 == 1][COG0183 ==1][,.( NperPhylum),by = .(Genome, Species, Phylum, Family_ID)])
Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.cons.dt <- unique(Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.dt[,.(Conservation = ( .N/NperPhylum)*100),by=.(Family_ID,Phylum, NperPhylum)])

Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.multi.dt <- Complex.CSBs.census.tax.Complex.dt[CSB_ID %in% unique(CSBs.census.tax.dt[COG1545 == 1][COG0183 ==1][Length == 2]$CSB_ID)][,.N,by = .(Genome, Species,Phylum, NperPhylum)][N>1]
Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.any.dt <- Complex.CSBs.census.tax.Complex.dt[CSB_ID %in% unique(CSBs.census.tax.dt[COG1545 == 1][COG0183 ==1][Length == 2]$CSB_ID)][,.N,by = .(Genome, Species,Phylum, NperPhylum)][N>0]

Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.any.cons.dt <- Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.any.dt[,.(Conservation = ( .N /NperPhylum)*100 ,averageCopy = mean(N)),by=.(Phylum,NperPhylum)]

Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.multi.cons.dt <- Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.multi.dt[,.(Conservation = ( .N /NperPhylum)*100,averageCopy = mean(N)),by=.(Phylum,NperPhylum)]

write.table(Complex.CSBs.census.tax.Complex.dt,file = "results/ComplexIslands.txt",sep = "\t",quote = F, row.names = F)
#Complex.CSBs.census.tax.Complex.dt[CSB_ID %in% unique(CSBs.census.tax.dt[COG1545 == 1][COG0183 ==1][Length == 2]$CSB_ID)]
```

## Including Plots



```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.cons.dt[Family_ID == 0],aes(Phylum, Conservation))+
  geom_col() +
  theme_light()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  ylab("Conserved in genomes [%]") +
  ggtitle("Genomes containing at least one ketothiolase/DUF35 domain protein pair per phylum")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100))

ggplot(Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.multi.cons.dt,aes(Phylum, Conservation))+
  geom_col() +
  theme_light()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  ylab("Conserved in genomes [%]") +
  #ggtitle("Genomes containing at least two ketothiolase/DUF35 domain protein pair per phylum")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100))+
  coord_flip()
ggsave(filename = "results/KT_DUF35_muli_conservation.pdf",device = "pdf", width = 4,height = 2)

ggplot(Complex.CSBFam.census.tax.Complex.any.dt[Phylum %in% c("p__Asgardarchaeota","p__Halobacteriota","p__Hadarchaeota", "p__Thermoplasmatota","p__Thermoproteota")],aes(Phylum, N))+
  geom_jitter(shape =21,alpha = 0.4)+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0,alpha = 0.9) +
  theme_light()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  ylab("Protein pairs per genome [n]") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,17))+
  coord_flip()
ggsave(filename = "results/KT_DUF35_copyN.pdf",device = "pdf", width = 4,height = 2)
```

```{r}
FA.cluster.dt <- unique(CSBs.census.tax.dt[completeness >= 0.7][,.( Length,CSB_ID,Family_ID),by = .(Genome, Species, Locus, Phylum, NperPhylum,CSB)])

FA.cluster.long.dt<- melt.data.table(CSBs.census.tax.dt[completeness >= 0.7,.(Genome, Species, Locus, Phylum,CSB_ID, Family_ID,COG0183,COG1028,COG1064,COG1250,COG1545,COG2030,COG1960)], id.vars = c("Genome","Species", "Locus", "Phylum", "CSB_ID","Family_ID"))
FA.cluster.cons.dt <- unique(FA.cluster.dt[,.(Conservation = ( .N/NperPhylum)*100),by=.(Family_ID,Phylum,CSB_ID,CSB, NperPhylum,Locus)])


ggplot(FA.cluster.cons.dt,aes(factor(Family_ID), Conservation))+
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Phylum), drop = T)+
  theme_light()+
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
  ylab("Conserved in phylum genomes [%]")
FA.cluster.long.comp.dt <- FA.cluster.long.dt[,.(N =sum(value)),by =.(Family_ID,variable)]
n_loci <- length(unique(FA.cluster.cons.dt$Locus)) +1
FA.cluster.long.comp.dt[,conservation := (N/n_loci)*100]
ggplot(FA.cluster.long.dt[Family_ID == 0 & value > 0]) + 
  geom_bar(aes(variable, fill = variable), position = position_dodge())

ggplot(FA.cluster.long.comp.dt[Family_ID == 0])+
  geom_col(aes(variable, conservation)) +
  theme_light()
```
